Maya (PM): Quick sync — we need to recalibrate RICE for next quarter. I feel like big enterprise asks are anchoring impact scores and pushing out shorter high-value platform work. Can we debias and discuss sequencing? @Alex @Sam?
Alex (Eng): Agree. We're seeing 'impact' dominated by a single enterprise pilot. Suggest splitting impact into buckets: revenue, operational cost saved, strategic/technical leverage. That should surface smaller but broad-impact items. :thinking:
Sam (Infra): From infra POV: batching and KV-cache work is medium effort (2 sprints), but reduces unit cost a lot. Routing/compatibility work is higher risk and needs canary windows. Sequencing matters to avoid release thrash.
Jo (Data): I ran a sensitivity on the current scores — if we normalize impact by median customer effect, "predictive cache" drops ~30% rank, whereas KMS + Private jumps less than we thought. I can share numbers. Quick snippet of the normalizer I used:
```
impact_norm = raw_impact / median(raw_impact across customers)
score = (reach * impact_norm * confidence) / effort
```
Prashant (PM, Ent.): Enterprise asks include KMS + audit + contract updates. High strategic impact but ~8 weeks dev. We could decompose into "KMS shim" (2w) + "audit pipeline" (6w) to get incremental wins and unblock sales.
Maya (PM): Proposed path: 1) run a debiased RICE pass where impact = weighted sum of (revenue_pct, ops_pct, strategic_pct) with weights we agree on; 2) add a "sequence cost" column that penalizes items that block many others; 3) rerun ranking and sanity-check against sales backlog. Can we get one-off scoring by EOD? :eyes:
Alex (Eng): I can do engineering effort re-estimates for the top 10 items today. Will flag any hidden infra dependencies.
Jo (Data): I'll produce the normalized spreadsheet and a small visualization showing rank shifts. Will post in this thread by 4pm.
Prashant (PM, Ent.): I'll split the enterprise epic into 2 smaller tickets and update the impact estimates. That should help earlier rollouts.
Maya (PM): Great — next steps: Alex (effort), Jo (normalized scores), Prashant (decompose epics). We'll reconvene tomorrow at 9am to lock the quarter. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
release-bot: Deployment dashboard updated for service 'predictive-cache' — latest canary at 2%.
